prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Extreme wide shot. Torrents of rain pour from black clouds onto a wide valley where a few low round black goat-hair tents stand scattered on open ground, tiny dark silhouettes in hooded ankle-length robes of rough brown wool, barefoot running between them, a fork of lightning splitting the sky and lighting the whole valley. Night, lightning and sheets of water. Overwhelming and loud. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
